record.paper: Polynomial bounds for chromatic number VII. Disjoint holes

dossier_meta.paper: Polynomial bounds for chromatic number VII. Disjoint holes
dossier_meta.catalog_title: Open problem (disjoint union of good trees)
dossier_meta.statement_text: It is not known that if trees $H_1$, $H_2$ are good (i.e., the class of $H_i$-free graphs is polynomially $\chi$-bounded for $i=1,2$), then the disjoint union of $H_1$ and $H_2$ is also good.
dossier_meta.context_text: Trees of diameter three are good [14], but whether disjoint unions of diameter-three trees are good is unknown. Self-isolation provides a sufficient condition: if $H_1$ and $H_2$ are good forests and one of them is self-isolating, their disjoint union is good.
